_about: Real art for Clean Up Crew. Put a transparent PNG or WebP (2x size) in this folder and list it here by name, e.g. "robot-wave": "robot-wave.webp". Names: robot-wave, robot-thumbs, robot-cheer, rhino, leopard, bin-blocks, bin-stuffies, bin-books, bin-clothes, brick, star-block, teddy, book, shirt, car, crayon, logo. Anything not listed uses the drawn stand-in.
